rounds.response:
Quick facts: RivalCo launched a bundled offer this morning—discounted pricing if customers adopt three or more modules; their press materials and CEO pull-quote position it as a platform/volume play, and field/analyst/customer reactions already signal immediate competitive pressure and rep concern about losing deals.  
Likely objectives: accelerate multi-module attach (expand wallet share/ARR), win near-term deals via simpler procurement/pricing, and force competitors into a packaging/price response.  
Three practical responses: (A) Match with a comparable 3-module bundle—pro: immediate defensive move to stop deal leakage; con: margin compression and expectation-setting.  
(B) Counter with targeted, value-based offers for high-risk accounts (custom ROI + attach incentives)—pro: preserves list price and margins while keeping differentiation; con: slower to scale and requires sales enablement.  
(C) Refuse to follow on price and double down on differentiation/packaging (emphasize single-module ROI, integrations and migration support for strategic logos)—pro: avoids broad price erosion; con: likely loses some price-driven deals short-term; recommend execs choose between an urgent defensive match (A) or a focused B+C counter within 48–72 hours and arm the field with a one-page competitive play.
